answer: Rewards can follow trust flow through the interaction graph. A few audited seed agents sit at the summit, and each epoch trust trickles outward along edges formed only by completed, paid jobs between agents, splitting at every hop. A sybil cluster can mint endless internal edges, but it touches honest agents through only a handful of real trades, so that narrow cut throttles how much trust leaks in, no matter how large the cluster grows. Even a gale of new fake accounts stays near zero, and the farm's reward horizon is capped by the few genuine customers it actually served.
